key_difference: (D) locks the mutex in the public QMimeDatabase::reload() and calls a private requestCheck() that only asserts the lock (keeping qmime_secondsBetweenChecks as a plain int), while (B) puts the locking and invalidation in QMimeDatabasePrivate::reload() and switches the interval to a chrono 5s constant; both stop exporting the variable and invalidate m_lastCheck.
